steps.title: Your first shift
steps.text: Prompts like this one guide you through a first patrol: the car, the radio, a call, a report and a traffic stop. Press {menu.toggle} to open the pause menu; it has Skip tutorial step and End tutorial.

steps.title: Get in the patrol car
steps.text: Walk to the patrol car in the lot and press {interact} to get in.

steps.title: Drive
steps.hint: The handbrake is {vehicle.handbrake}. The camera changes with {camera.toggle}.

steps.title: Emergency lights
steps.text: Emergency lights {vehicle.lights}, siren {vehicle.siren}. Switch the light bar on.
steps.hint: Traffic pulls over for lights and siren; the light bar also starts a traffic stop later.

steps.title: Go in service
steps.text: Open the radio {radio.menu}, choose 1 Status, then In service. With a gamepad use the D-pad ({radio.cursorNext}) and {radio.cursorSelect} to select.
steps.hint: Dispatch only offers calls to units that are in service.

steps.title: Take a call
steps.text: Dispatch offers you a call: accept it with the radio ({radio.menu}, then 7) or in the MDT ({mdt.toggle}; on a gamepad: Start > MDT).
steps.hint: The call is an abandoned vehicle a few hundred metres away.

steps.title: Drive to the call
steps.text: Follow the route on the minimap; you arrive on scene automatically.
steps.hint: Obey the traffic laws unless you run with lights and siren.

steps.title: Handle the scene
steps.text: Look around, talk to people ({interact}), open the scene panel {scene.menu} (gamepad: Start > Scene actions) and clear the call.

steps.title: Write the report
steps.text: Write the incident report: MDT {mdt.toggle} (gamepad: Start > MDT) > Reports > New report; tick the statements you can support and submit.
steps.hint: Only write what you observed or were told.

steps.title: Make a traffic stop
steps.text: Find a car, get behind it and switch on the light bar to pull it over.

steps.title: Run the plate
steps.hint: Look at the car, then press the key; dispatch reads the result back.

steps.title: Contact the driver
steps.text: Walk to the driver window, press {interact}, ask for the licence, then warn, cite or release.

steps.title: Call for backup
steps.text: Need help? Radio {radio.menu} > 4 Request > backup. Try it now (or skip).

steps.title: That is the job
steps.text: Citations and arrests go to court: hearings show in the MDT Career tab. Free patrol is next; the radio and MDT keys are in Settings.
